summary: 巴西皮拉罕语引发了关于数词、递归结构以及语言与思维关系的争论。埃弗里特用当地文化解释语言特点，其他语言的对照和学界异议又提出了新的验证问题。
logic: 质疑递归推论与研究方式

paragraphs.brief: Pirahan部落居住在巴西亚马逊森林深处，语言学家激烈辩论其语言。
sentences: The Pirahã tribe live deep in Brazil’s Amazon forest, and their language is hotly debated by linguists.
Pirahan部落居住在巴西亚马逊森林深处，语言学家激烈辩论其语言。
Since 1977, the ethnologist Daniel Everett has spent a total of seven years living with the Pirahã and has committed his career to studying their puzzling speech.
自1977年以来，民族学家丹尼尔·埃弗雷特共与皮拉昂人生活了七年，并致力于研究他们令人费解的演讲。
Indeed, he was uncertain for so long about what he was actually hearing while living among the Pirahã that he waited nearly three decades before publishing his findings.
事实上，他一直不确定自己在Pirahan居住期间实际听到什么，等待了将近30年才公布其调查结果。

paragraphs.brief: 有关Pirahan语言的争论，直达关于智人如何发展声波交流的谜题的核心。
sentences: The debate over the Pirahã language goes right to the core of the riddle regarding how Homo sapiens managed to develop vocal communication.
有关Pirahan语言的争论，直达关于智人如何发展声波交流的谜题的核心。

Although bees dance, birds sing and whales even sing with syntax, human language is unique, if only for the reason that it enables humans to piece together never-before-constructed thoughts, and be infinitely imaginative - think of Shakespeare’s plays or Einstein’s theory of relativity.
尽管蜜蜂跳舞，鸟儿唱歌，鲸鱼甚至用语法唱歌，但人类语言是独特的，即使只是因为它使人类能够拼凑出从未构思过的思想，并且具有无限的想象力 — — 想想莎士比亚的剧本或爱因斯坦的相对论。

paragraphs.brief: 语言一般侧重于所有人类语言的共同特征，但Pirahã语与某些学者长期以来坚持的语言不同，是所有人类语言的基本和不可分割的特点。
sentences: Linguistics generally focuses on what features all human languages have in common, but the Pirahã language departs from what some academics have long maintained are essential and inalienable features of all human languages.
语言一般侧重于所有人类语言的共同特征，但Pirahã语与某些学者长期以来坚持的语言不同，是所有人类语言的基本和不可分割的特点。
Most of all, it may be unique for not employing subordinate clauses.
最重要的是，它可能是独特的，因为没有使用附属条款。
Instead of saying, ‘When I have finished eating, I will speak to you,’ the Pirahã say, ‘I finish eating, I speak with you.’
彼拉罕人不说、我吃完了、我要和你说话。彼拉大人说、我吃完了了，我也和你同说话
Equally perplexing, the Pirahã appear not to use numbers.
同样令人困惑的是，Pirahan人似乎没有使用数字。
During the time he spent with them, Everett never heard words like ‘all’, ‘every’ and ‘more’.
Everett在和他们在一起期间，从未听到过“所有”、“每个”和“更多”这样的词。
There is one word, ‘hoi’, that comes close to the numeral 1, but it can also mean ‘small’.
有一个词，"哦"，接近数字1，但它也可以表示"小"。
And they were never observed to count without language, on their fingers for example, in order to determine important tasks in village life like how many pieces of meat to grill.
他们没有被观察到没有语言，他们的手指上，以便决定重要的任务在乡村生活像有多少肉片烤。

paragraphs.brief: 埃弗雷特在皮拉昂的研究结果为语言学家本杰明·胡夫的争议理论带来了新生活，他建议人们只能构思他们拥有实际语言的思想。
sentences: Everett’s findings among the Pirahã have brought new life to a controversial theory by the linguist Benjamin Whorf, who suggested that people are only capable of constructing thoughts for which they possess actual words.
埃弗雷特在皮拉昂的研究结果为语言学家本杰明·胡夫的争议理论带来了新生活，他建议人们只能构思他们拥有实际语言的思想。
Or to put it another way, because they have no words for numbers, they cannot even begin to understand the concept of numbers or arithmetic.
换句话说，他们甚至无法开始理解数字或算术的概念，因为他们对数字没有语言。

paragraphs.brief: 瓦尔皮里语—— 由一群澳大利亚原住民说—— 和皮拉昂语一样，仅具有最基本的计算系统。
sentences: The Warlpiri language - spoken by a group of Australian Aborigines - like that of the Pirahã, features only the most rudimentary system of counting.
瓦尔皮里语—— 由一群澳大利亚原住民说—— 和皮拉昂语一样，仅具有最基本的计算系统。

However, the Warlpiri people had no difficulty counting farther than three in a foreign language, in this case English, but when Everett attempted to teach the Pirahã how to count in Portuguese, like other Brazilians, not a single person could count to 10.
然而，Warlpiric人用一种外语(此处指英语)数得并不难，但当Everett试图教Pirahã人如何用葡萄牙语计算时，像其他巴西人一样，没有一个人能算到10。

paragraphs.brief: Everett很痛苦地指出，Pirahã人并非一无所知，因为他们的思想并不比普通大学生的思维慢。
sentences: Everett is at pains to point out that the Pirahã are not unintelligent, for their thinking is not any slower than that of the average university student.
Everett很痛苦地指出，Pirahã人并非一无所知，因为他们的思想并不比普通大学生的思维慢。

And although they reside in a remote part of the forest, they do not live in complete genetic isolation, but mix with people from the surrounding populations and share similar intellectual capacities with their neighbours whose languages do contain numbers.
虽然他们居住在森林的偏僻地区，但他们并不生活在完全的遗传隔离之中，而是与周围人口混在一起，与语言确实含有数字的邻居分享类似的智力能力。

paragraphs.brief: 最终，经过大约30年的研究，埃弗雷特对皮拉语的特殊性提出了令人惊讶的解释。
sentences: Eventually, after some 30 years of research, Everett has come up with a surprising explanation for the peculiarities of the Pirahã language.
最终，经过大约30年的研究，埃弗雷特对皮拉语的特殊性提出了令人惊讶的解释。
Language, he believes, is created by a people’s way of life, their belief system and values.
他认为，语言是由人民的生活方式、信仰体系和价值观所创造的。
In this way, variety in human language is almost limitless, a function of the human capacity to live in different ways, such as in the forest.
这样，人类语言的多样性几乎是无限的，这是人类以不同方式生活的能力的函数，例如在森林中。
What Everett’s research has revealed is that the central tenet of the Pirahã culture is to live in the here and now.
Everett的研究揭示了皮拉昂文化的核心原则就是生活在现在。
The only thing of importance that is worth communicating to others is what is being experienced at that very moment, though this can often be described with great care and detail.
唯一值得向他人传达的重要信息是当时正在经历的情况，尽管这常常可以非常小心和详细地加以描述。
In consequence, the language has no means to conjugate verbs in order to describe ‘yesterday’ or ‘last week’ or ‘when I was a child’.
因此，语言无法混为一谈，以描述 " 周末 " 或 " 上个星期 "，或 " 当我还是个孩子 "。

Their very literal view of the world curtails abstract thought, and many features taken for granted among other peoples are absent among the Pirahã, such as a creation myth, storytelling and painting.
他们对世界的字面观限制了抽象的思想，在皮拉昂人中，许多被视为理所当然的特征，例如创造神话、讲故事和绘画，都不存在。
One manifestation of their beliefs is that by tradition the names they give their children are not particularly imaginative.
他们信仰的一个表现是，根据传统，他们给其子女取的名字并不特别富有想象力。
Often they are named after other members of the tribe with whom they share similar character traits.
他们常常以他们具有类似性格的部落其他成员的名字命名。
Standing out or being different is not encouraged by the Pirahã, and this is reflected in their perhaps colourless choice of names.
皮拉昂人并不鼓励他们站出来或与众不同，这反映在他们可能没有颜色的取名上。

paragraphs.brief: 如果皮拉昂语不构成附属条款，那么复发就无法解释人类语言的独特性，这将否定乔姆斯基的理论。
sentences: Everett anticipated that these findings would be controversial and the reaction came as expected.
埃弗雷特预计，这些调查结果将引起争议，反应也如预期的那样。
Until this point, many linguists had defended the theories of Noam Chomsky, according to which all human languages have a universal grammar.
在此之前，许多语言学家一直捍卫诺姆·乔姆斯基的理论，根据这种理论，所有人类语言都有通用语法。
What exactly makes up this universal grammar is the subject of debate, but at its heart is the concept of ‘recursion’, which is defined as replication of a structure within its single parts.
这个通用语法究竟是什么，是辩论的主题，但核心是 " 递增 " 的概念，它被定义为在单一部分内复制一个结构。
Without it, humans would not be able to view separate thoughts as subordinate parts of a complex whole.
没有它，人类就无法将不同的思想视为一个复杂的整体的从属部分。
And, most pertinent to Everett’s work, there would not be subordinate clauses, which are responsible for translating the concept of recursion into grammar.
而且，与Everett的工作最相关的是，不会有附属条款，这些条款负责将重复的概念转化为语法。
But if the Pirahã do not form subordinate clauses, then recursion cannot explain the uniqueness of human language, and this would negate Chomsky’s theories.
如果皮拉昂语不构成附属条款，那么复发就无法解释人类语言的独特性，这将否定乔姆斯基的理论。

paragraphs.brief: 唯一的问题是，没有人能证实或否认埃弗雷特的观察，因为没有任何其他研究人员能像他那样讲皮拉昂语。
sentences: The logical way forward now would be to try to prove that the Pirahã can think in a recursive fashion.
现在合乎逻辑的前进方向是试图证明皮拉昂人可以反复思考。
The only problem is, nobody can confirm or deny Everett’s observations since no other researcher can speak Pirahã as well as he does.
唯一的问题是，没有人能证实或否认埃弗雷特的观察，因为没有任何其他研究人员能像他那样讲皮拉昂语。
Despite this, several researchers - including two of Chomsky’s colleagues - will soon travel to Brazil to check his claims.
尽管如此，包括两名Chomsky的同事在内的几位研究人员将很快前往巴西，检查他的申报。
My concern is that soon the Pirahã will simply become one more scientific oddity with every aspect of their lives being exploited and analysed.
我担心的是，很快皮拉昂人将成为一个科学奇特，其生活的每个方面都将受到剥削和分析。

items.en: What are we told about Daniel Everett in the first paragraph?
items.zh: 丹尼尔·埃弗雷特在第一段里怎么说的？
correct: Studying the Pirahã language is the focus of his work.
学习皮拉昂语是他工作的重点。

items.en: Which of the following is the best summary of the second paragraph?
items.zh: 以下哪些是第二段的最佳摘要？
correct: Humans are the only species to be linguistically creative.
人类是唯一具有语言创造力的物种。

items.en: Why does the writer refer to subordinate clauses?
items.zh: 作者为什么提到次要条款？
correct: to exemplify an unusual feature of the Pirahã language
来展示皮拉昂语的不寻常特征

items.en: What point does the writer make about the work of Whorf?
items.zh: 作家对Whorf的作品有什么看法？
correct: His theory might be supported by Everett’s research.
他的想法可能得到Everett研究的支持。

items.en: The writer refers to the Warlpiri people in order to
correct: illustrate the uniqueness of the Pirahã.
说明皮拉昂人的独特性。

items.en: What is Everett’s point about the Pirahã’s intellectual capacities?
correct: He does not want people to criticise their intelligence.
他不希望人们批评他们的智慧。

items.en: Everett believes that a group’s language is a product of their ________ and thus language is infinitely varied.
items.zh: 埃弗里特认为，一个群体的语言是其 ________ 的产物，因此语言能够呈现无穷的变化。
items.why: “生活方式、信仰与价值" 即文化，说明语言源自群体文化。

items.en: During the time he spent living among them, he observed that the Pirahã only place value on the ________ and have no ____ (Q35) to describe completed events.
items.zh: 与皮拉罕人共同生活时，他观察到他们只重视 ________，也没有用来描述已完成事件的 ________（Q35）。
items.why: 强调只重当下，对应 present。

items.en: During the time he spent living among them, he observed that the Pirahã only place value on the ____ (Q34) and have no ________ to describe completed events.
items.zh: 与皮拉罕人共同生活时，他观察到他们只重视 ________（Q34），也没有用来描述已完成事件的 ________。
items.why: “无动词变化的手段"= 缺乏表达完成事件 (过去/完成体) 的语法，对应 grammar。

items.en: Similarly, the types of names they use reflect the fact that they do not celebrate ________.
items.zh: 同样，他们采用的名字类型也反映出，他们并不推崇 ________。
items.why: 不鼓励“突出/不同”,即不庆祝个体性/个体特质。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

items.en: Everett was surprised by the way his research was greeted.
items.zh: 埃弗雷特对他的研究受到欢迎的方式感到惊讶。
items.why: 题干说他“感到惊讶”,而原文说预料之中，故相反。

items.en: Chomsky has been critical of Everett’s research methodology.
items.why: 计划去巴西核查埃弗里特主张的是研究者，其中有乔姆斯基的两位同事。既未说乔姆斯基本人参与，也未说他批评了研究方法。

items.en: If ‘recursion’ as a universal concept is disproved, Chomsky’s ideas about language would be wrong.
items.zh: 如果“翻转”这个普遍概念被推翻，乔姆斯基对语言的看法就是错误的。
items.why: 若“递归”作为普遍概念被推翻/不适用，则乔氏语言理论会被否定。

items.en: The Pirahã will benefit from their new-found status among academics.
items.zh: 皮拉昂人将受益于他们在学术界中的新地位。
items.why: 作者担忧他们会被当作“科学奇观”而被过度利用，并非“受益”。

pairs: 题干说这项研究是工作的重心，原文写他把职业生涯投入到研究这种语言上。
a people’s way of life, their belief system and values
题干用 culture 概括生活方式、信仰体系和价值观，这几项正是原文列出的文化要素。
what is being experienced at that very moment
present 在此作名词，指“当下”，原文将其展开为“此时此刻正在经历的事”。
第 3 段 · 第 7 句
points: 计划去巴西核查埃弗里特主张的是研究者，其中有乔姆斯基的两位同事。既未说乔姆斯基本人参与，也未说他批评了研究方法。
“无动词变化的手段"= 缺乏表达完成事件 (过去/完成体) 的语法，对应 grammar。
clauses: Or to put it another way, …, they cannot even begin to understand the concept of numbers or arithmetic.
连接词 because 引出“because they have no words for numbers”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。

And …, they do not live in complete genetic isolation, but mix with people from the surrounding populations and share similar intellectual capacities with their neighbours whose languages do contain numbers.
连接词 although 引出“although they reside in a remote part of the forest”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: The Pirahã language has stirred up debate among experts
皮拉昂语引发了专家之间的争论
